title: Search-Eval Query Pack
description: The terms to be evaluated, each carrying its answer key where one exists. Replaces the hand-authored [[term, dataset]] tuple list, which had no denominator: a grade scores what came back, never what was missed. Terms without a key (job_function, intent) are legitimate but must declare has_key=false so the board cannot imply recall coverage it does not have.

catalog_ref.description: Path to the catalog.json the keys were derived from. Required when any term has_key=true.

source.description: How the term was selected into the dataset (category-recall SKILL §6). catalog_node = matches a real category node; catalog_facet = synthesized from a node x facet value; authored = hand-typed shopper vocabulary the taxonomy has no category for; use_case = job/task phrasing; natural_language = conversational query; part_number = exact known-item part-number lookup (the head of parts-catalog demand, not answer-key-generable); mined = discovered from recall misses. Rendered as a per-term source chip on the board.

relation.description: L06/L07. node_attr is a node crossed with a cross-cutting facet value (loafers x closure=slip-on) and is NOT a node equivalence. hyponym expands upward only.

direction.description: L06. Default uni. bi requires both directions proven, because bidirectional pairs chain transitively (shoe<->boot, boot<->trunk).

has_key.description: Whether this term has a catalog-derived answer key. False for intent and job_function terms, which have no node and no filter.

query_template.description: How the term string was synthesized, e.g. '{facet_value} {node.singular}'. The synthesized string is a PROXY for shopper phrasing, not the real query - do not present it as one.

confidence.description: L02/L05. low when facet null_rate is high or facet_provenance is text_classifier/unknown. A low-confidence key must not drive a precision finding.

compared_to.description: Canonical lead term for synonym rows. Renders as 'term vs canonical' in the drill-down.

orphans.description: Synonym-dataset terms with neither compared_to nor a variant pointing at them. The hand-authored pack produced these silently (oxfords had no partner because nobody typed one); surfacing them is a gate, not a note.
